summary: Iteration 3 focused on auto-scroll feature testing. All 7 features from the review request were tested. Auto-scroll works correctly for both individual and group chats. One pre-existing UX issue found: pressing back from a group chat (opened from Groups tab) returns to Conversas tab instead of Groups tab.

issues: MINOR/PRE-EXISTING: openChat() always sets activeTab='chats' (line 425 ChatApp.js). When user navigates from Groups tab → clicks a group → presses ← back, they land on Conversas tab instead of Grupos tab. The renderGroups() chat view (with data-testid='chat-back-btn-groups') is unreachable dead code because openChat() overrides the tab to 'chats'. This was not introduced by the auto-scroll feature.

action_items: LOW/OPTIONAL: Fix openChat() in ChatApp.js (line 425) to preserve the originating tab. When handleGroupItemClick calls openChat(), the back button should return to Groups tab, not Conversas. Suggested fix: pass originating tab as parameter to openChat() and restore it in handleBack(). critical_code_review_comments: ChatApp.js line 421-426: openChat() always sets setActiveTab('chats') regardless of originating tab. This makes renderGroups() chat view branch (lines 561-601) unreachable/dead code. The data-testid='chat-back-btn-groups' button at line 566 is never rendered. This is a pre-existing UX regression: navigating Groups → Group Chat → Back lands on Conversas instead of Grupos.

ChatApp.js lines 470-502: Auto-scroll implementation using MutationObserver is correct. The 400ms setTimeout + MutationObserver combination works well for both initial load and new messages. scrollToBottom() correctly targets .cometchat-message-list first, falling back to container/firstElementChild.

back_from_groups_returns_to_chats.root_cause: openChat() (ChatApp.js line 421) always calls setActiveTab('chats') regardless of which tab the user came from. handleGroupItemClick calls openChat(null, group) which forces chats tab. handleBack() (line 440) only sets inChatView=false without restoring the originating tab.
back_from_groups_returns_to_chats.reproduction: Login → Grupos tab → click Pre-Natal group → press ← back → observe Conversas tab is now active instead of Grupos
back_from_groups_returns_to_chats.mitigation: Modify openChat() to accept an optional 'fromTab' parameter. In handleBack(), restore activeTab to the saved fromTab value. Remove dead code in renderGroups() chat view branch.
back_from_groups_returns_to_chats.severity: LOW - functionality works, only UX/navigation issue
